name: Mezcal Mule
description: Mezcal, lime and muddled cucumber topped with ginger beer.
history: Jim Meehan’s version at PDT in New York, with passion fruit and agave, made it a modern classic. This one leaves out the passion fruit.
whyItWorks: Ginger and smoke both read as heat; cucumber and lime cool them down. Mezcal gives the mule a savory floor vodka never could.
steps: Muddle two cucumber slices in a shaker.
Add mezcal, lime and agave; shake with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled mug and top with ginger beer.
techniqueNotes: For the PDT version, add 0.75 oz passion fruit purée and drop the agave.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Mixing mezcal with enough smoke to show through ginger.
